info.name: Optibus Operations Driver Absences Work Entities API

params.name: depotId
params.description: - Optional. The ID of a specific depot for which workEntities are to be retrieved.

params.name: driverIds
params.description: - Optional. An array of driver IDs for whom workEntities are to be retrieved.

params.name: startDate
params.description: - The start date of the workEntities period.

params.name: endDate
params.description: - The end date of the workEntities period.

params.name: exportAllEntities
params.description: - Optional. If true, all workEntities will be exported, regardless of the configuration.

params.name: shouldUseCache
params.description: - Optional. Will attempt to retreive the data from the cache if true. If false, will always calculate the data.

items.docs:
Retrieves workEntities values for depots within a specified date range and for specified driver IDs or by depotId.
There is a limit of 204k work-entities calculation per request to avoid timeouts. This limit enables, for example,
a calculation of 100 drivers for 30 days with 100 daily work-entities defined. In case the limit is exceeded, a 413 error code will be returned, together with the allowed amount of drivers for the existing configuration.

info.name: Fetch work engine API calculation limit

params.name: startDate
params.description: - The start date of the calculation period.

params.name: endDate
params.description: - The end date of the calculation period.

params.name: mode
params.description: - Optional. The flow for which to compute the limit (`payroll` or `workEntities`). Defaults to `payroll`.

items.docs:
Fetches the maximum number of drivers allowed per API request for the given dates for a particular client.
To prevent timeouts, there is a cap of 204000 work-entity calculations per request. This cap allows, for instance,
the calculation of 100 drivers over a 30-day period with 100 daily work-entities specified.
